name: Benzarone

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany, first in 1992 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benziodarone
problems: Pulled from the market in France and United Kingdom, first in 1964 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benzbromarone
problems: Pulled from the market in France and Portugal, first in 2003 — for liver harm

similar.name: Amiodarone
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, breathing problems and liver harm

summary: Benzarone was pulled from the market in Germany starting in 1992 because of liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Benzarone a medium score of 56 for liver risk and a low score of 14 for heart risk [M]. Other drugs that are chemically similar have also been pulled from markets in France, the United Kingdom, and Portugal for liver harm [3][4]. Another similar drug carries a boxed warning in the United States for harm to the heart, breathing, and liver [5].
